card.name: Space before hour or minute counts
card.fires_on: The space right after 'at least', 'every', 'approximately' or 'within' just before a number of hours or minutes. It also fires on pieces of the number in PEG-3350 and on 'until' in eating instructions.

modes.label: Space before time counts
modes.description: The blank space before a number of hours or minutes in timing instructions.
modes.example: Stop consumption of all fluids at least<< >>2 hours prior to the colonoscopy

modes.label: Wait-until wording
modes.description: The word 'until' in instructions about not eating or drinking.
modes.example: Advise patients not to eat or drink anything<< until>> the tablet is completely dissolved.

card.writes: It seems to push toward time-span words like year or annual and away from words like morning, overnight or daily.
card.plain: It fires where a time span such as 2 hours is about to be given in prep or dosing instructions.
